video_title: “We’ll Get Better Each Game.” | Ayo Dosunmu & Terrence Shannon Jr. Postgame Sound | 10.7.26

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu and Terrence Shannon Jr. on defensive rebounding improvements
quotes.excerpt: I have to do a better job boxing out. And I think that's the main thing

text_blocks.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
text_blocks.text: I think we just have to do a better job. I know for sure watching the film, I have to do a better job boxing out. And I think that's the main thing, boxing out and then pursuing the rebound.

text_blocks.speaker: Terrence Shannon Jr.
text_blocks.text: A lot of the times the rebound we have been giving up, it's just been easy, easy fundamental things that we can clean up. So, trying to do a better job of cleaning that up for the next game in Miami.

quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu says the team needs to focus on fundamentals to fix their rebounding issues. He noted that they are giving up too many easy boards and need to do a better job boxing out before their next game in Miami.

quotes.speaker: Terrence Shannon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Terrence Shannon Jr. on his ability to guard the four position
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I'm physically able to guard a four. I just got to do a better job
quotes.quote: I feel like I'm physically able to guard a four. Like you said, I just got to do a better job of rebounding, you know, boxing out, and I feel like we'll be good. We'll get better each game.
quotes.social_post: Terrence Shannon Jr. believes he is physically capable of guarding the four position. He says his main focus is improving his rebounding and boxing out as he continues to get better each game.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the team's offensive execution and decision-making
quotes.excerpt: I think we did a great job of the initial attack getting downhill and then making
quotes.quote: I think we did a great job of the initial attack getting downhill and then making, spray out threes. I think that's going to be very vital for us as a team as we continue to get closer and closer to opening night, making the right play, getting a lot of threes up, and also being decisive, having a 0.5 decision-making. So, I think that's what we did pretty well tonight.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu is pleased with the team's offensive execution. He highlighted their ability to attack downhill and create spray out threes, emphasizing the importance of 0.5 decision making as they approach opening night.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on Tyrese Maxey's return from injury
quotes.excerpt: Health is always most important to anybody in the NBA. Always pray for health and safety
quotes.quote: Health is always most important to anybody in the NBA. Always pray for health and safety. So, for him to come back and be able to play the game that he loves to play, that's all God. So, I'll continue to, you know, pray for him, pray for his family as he gets back to do what he loves to do.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu shared his support for Tyrese Maxey following his return from injury. He noted that health is the most important thing for any player in the league.
